scientific_integrity.exact_domain: Positive three-point Fourier-Stieltjes transforms in Euclidean dimension at least two; strict mass triangle for sharp bound; affine rank two for zero-coset formula.
scientific_integrity.novelty_limit: Literature priority is conditional on inspected coverage; equivalent phasor-array literature cannot be excluded.
scientific_integrity.proof_basis: Three-vector phasor geometry, exact shortest-arc bound, Cauchy-Schwarz equality and Gram-inverse linear congruences.

scientific_limitations: No claim for more than three atoms, complex weights or complex frequencies.
Equality classification requires a strict triangle of weights; rank-two zero formula requires noncollinear sites.
Finite floating point tests only supplement the analytic argument.
title: Sharp diameter thresholds and zero lattices for positive three-atomic Fourier transforms
